answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 19 identities per epoch. Audits are logged in harbor, queued in ridge, and lantern publishes the wait time. A farm of 270 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 3011 identities would post 704 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
